summary: Join our International Development Leadership and Management Course to gain essential skills for effective leadership and sustainable development practices.
lede: International development leadership and management helps program managers connect program goals with coordinated, measurable delivery. Designed for program managers and development specialists, it covers developing Theory of Change models with stakeholder input, setting SMART indicators, leading cross-functional teams, and using monitoring and learning to adapt plans and report results.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who are moving into leadership roles or seeking to formalize their management expertise within the international aid and development sector.
modules: Strategic Design with Theory of Change
The Logical Framework Approach in Practice
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in the development or humanitarian sector. Familiarity with basic project cycles is recommended. No advanced financial or statistical knowledge is required, as the course covers foundational to intermediate management tools.
